_comment: Consent texts both plugins must give, word for word. `signed_in` is printed after `{cmd} sentrook login` stores the credentials, one sentence per line: the `{terms}` line is `terms_line` (with `terms_line_dated` when a date is given) only when the identity service's answer gives a `terms_version` (and `terms_accepted_at`), and is left out otherwise; {links} is the privacy policy URL and, when set, the terms URL, joined by ` and `; {stop} is the host's command that stops all scans (`hosts`). `withdrawn_notice` is the one owner notice sent when the identity service refuses the scan credentials because consent was withdrawn (`token_error`): {reconnect} and {observe} are the host's. `rendered` is each host's text with no terms version. Hermes under `plugins.isolation: host` has no command line and sends `reconnect_by_hand` instead, with {observe} filled.
_draft: The terms URL is not known yet: each plugin's TERMS_URL is empty, so the terms link is left out. Set it there and in `terms_url` here together.

body.error_description: Sentrook consent withdrawn: run sentrook login to reconnect

signed_in: Sentrook is connected to your FIDU account.
Each check sends the action and its context to Sentrook, which may pass it to OpenRouter and TypeSafe to judge.
Secrets are replaced with placeholders before anything leaves your machine; other personal data is sent as it is.
Sentrook is a beta and does not guarantee protection.
To stop, run {stop} or close your FIDU account.
withdrawn_notice: Sentrook consent withdrawn: scans stopped. Run {reconnect} to connect again, or switch to observe mode, or uninstall. Observe mode: {observe}

hermes.stop: hermes plugins disable sentrook && hermes gateway restart
hermes.observe: hermes config set plugins.entries.sentrook.settings.mode observe && hermes gateway restart
hermes.reconnect_by_hand: Sentrook consent withdrawn: scans stopped. Set new credentials in Hermes (see the install guide) to connect again, or switch to observe mode, or uninstall. Observe mode: {observe}

openclaw.stop: openclaw plugins disable sentrook && openclaw gateway restart
openclaw.observe: openclaw config set plugins.entries.sentrook.config.mode observe && openclaw gateway restart
